summary: Iteration 5 full backend+frontend testing. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py with 24 pytest cases covering /api/stats, email-verify gate (unverified after register, wrong-code 400, resend 200, auth required), reviews (owner-self 400, non-owner add/update, GET stats, views bump on GET /company/{id}), photo comments (POST/GET, auth required), avatar upload (multipart, bad ext 400), notifications (visitor unread from company reply, company unread from visitor msg, auth required), admin (non-admin 403, stats/users/companies, admin can't delete admin 400, throwaway user+company delete works & login fails after). All 24/24 pass; full regression suite 89/89 pass. Frontend Playwright: (1) Home stats visible (companies/users/countries), (2) exactly 3 featured cards Italy/Germany/Georgia with images and correct order, (3) search input reveals country + city results (France 1 country / 6 cities; Germany 1), (4) footer-policy-link -> /policy -> back arrow works, (5) register throwaway -> redirect /verify-email; wrong 6-digit code stays on page (400 toast); GET /dashboard while unverified redirects back to /verify-email; resend-code-button succeeds, (6) admin login -> /admin (bypasses ProtectedRoute), stat cards populated, users tab shows admin-user-row list, companies tab shows admin-company-row, nav-admin visible for admin only (regular user: not present), (7) user_verified login -> user dashboard has tab-profile+tab-settings only (no gallery/messages); avatar upload via input[type=file] works; user-name-input + save-user-profile-button persist name, (8) comp_verified login -> company dashboard has all 4 tabs (profile/gallery/messages/settings) and unread badge on messages, (9) PublicProfile /company/{id}: profile-back-button, profile-stats (rating/views/media), profile-message-button visible for non-owner; posting review with star-5 + review-text-input + review-submit-button updates rating-avg to 5 and shows review-item, (10) gallery-photo click opens PhotoDialog; posting via photo-comment-input + photo-comment-send appends photo-comment, (11) notification-bell renders on Home for non-admin; admin panel delete-user AlertDialog confirm removes the target row (verified via re-render). No blocking bugs found.

integration_issues.issue: profile-stats block continues to show stale rating/count (0) after user submits a review — only Reviews subcomponent state updates. Refresh required for stats block. Minor UX only.

issues: Radix console warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility. Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to /app/frontend/src/components/PhotoDialog.jsx.

Dashboard.jsx uses a CUSTOM header (not the shared Header component) so notification-bell does NOT render on /dashboard for logged-in users — only on Home/PublicProfile/Policy. Minor UX inconsistency; the spec says 'logged-in non-admin header shows notification-bell' which is technically true only for pages using shared Header.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In PhotoDialog.jsx add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to silence Radix a11y warning.
OPTIONAL: After Reviews submit, also update PublicProfile.company.rating_avg/review_count so profile-stats block stays in sync without page reload.
OPTIONAL: Show NotificationBell on the Dashboard header too (currently only on shared Header pages).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 866 lines — auth, company, reviews, media, chat, admin, notifications all in one file. Split into routers/ package soon.
add_review calls await get_reviews(company_id) which re-queries and computes rating_stats twice per POST (once in the update branch, once in get_reviews). Harmless but avoidable double-work.
GET /company/{id} increments views on EVERY hit including owner's own views and repeated refreshes — no dedup by session/user. Slight metric skew; not critical for MVP.

admin_delete_company deletes company + owner user but does NOT delete other companies owned by same user, nor password_resets/verifications/photo_comments left orphaned. Same partial cleanup issue in admin_delete_user (photo_comments left orphaned).

NotificationBell polls every 10s and returns full items[] each time — for admin the polling still fires and (since role==admin, else branch runs) queries messages by visitor_id=admin.id, returning []. OK, but the bell itself is hidden for admin in Header, so no visible effect. Wasted request only if admin hits a public page.
PublicProfile: after Reviews submit, `company.rating_avg`/`review_count` in the parent state are stale (profile-stats block shows old values). Small UI polish.
PhotoDialog missing DialogTitle -> Radix accessibility console warning.
